name: @mcp-s/image-generation-mcp

tools.name: generate-image
tools.description: Generate an image from a text prompt using Google Gemini. Default: MCP image content for chat preview. Set inline to false to get a single text part containing JSON { mimeType, data (base64), sizeBytes } for upload APIs (no temp files).

prompt.description: The text prompt describing the image to generate

inline.description: If true (default), return only image content. If false, return only one text part with JSON including base64 data (easier to pipe into Drive/upload tools).
